answer_1.quote: We propose a new learning-based framework, AGREE, Adaptation of LLMs for GRounding EnhancEment... to generate grounded responses based on the retrieved passages as well as include citations in their responses.

answer_2.quote: We report the citation recall (rec) and citation precision (pre) on all the evaluation datasets... For NQ, we report exact match recall (emrec)... For StrategyQA, we report the accuracy (acc)... For ASQA and QAMPARI... em-rec... rec-5
